# Load dataset

```{r}
pop=read_xlsx("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Data\\population_dur.xlsx")
```

## Select some patients to run functions

Divide into treated and untreated

```{r}
trt=pop %>% filter(trt==1)
untrt=pop %>% filter(trt==0)
```

Smaller sample size

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
dftrial=rbind(trt[sample(1:nrow(trt),15),],
            untrt[sample(1:nrow(untrt),150),])
```

# Test procedures

## Exact matching

### single procedure

```{r}
matched=matching(data=dftrial,treatment=trt,ageofonset=ageonset,sex=sex,
                 duration=duration,time=time,method='greedy',
                 caliper=0.5,step=0.1,maxcaliper=0.5,ratio=2,
                 replacement=F,history=F,warning=T)
# extract dataset
matcheddf=matched$dataset
```

Run model

```{r}
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
beta=coefficients(model)["trt"]
```

### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       full_data=dftrial,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimate="surv_hr",
       estimand="ATT",
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       method="exact")
```

Print estimates

```{r}
est=B$t0
lower=B$t0-1.96*sd(B$t)
upper=B$t0+1.96*sd(B$t)
# difference
est-beta
```

## PSM

### glm

#### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching(data=dftrial,
                     formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                     ratio=2,
                     replacement=F,
                     distance='glm',
                     method='optimal',
                     #tune=TRUE,
                     caliper=NULL,
                     duration=duration,
                     time=time)
```

Get data and run cox model to check results

```{r}
# get data
matcheddf=matched$dataset
# run cox model
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
beta=coefficients(model)["trt"]
```

### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       full_data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimate="surv_hr",
       search=list(psm="optimal"),
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       method="psm")
```

Print estimates

```{r}
est=B$t0
lower=B$t0-1.96*sd(B$t)
upper=B$t0+1.96*sd(B$t)
lower; est; upper
# difference
est-beta
```

### random forest

#### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching(data=dftrial,
                     formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                     ratio=2,
                     replacement=F,
                     distance='random forest',
                     method='greedy',
                     tune=TRUE,
                     caliper=NULL,
                     duration=duration,
                     time=time)
```

Get data and run cox model to check results

```{r}
# get data
matcheddf=matched$dataset
# run cox model
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
beta=coefficients(model)["trt"]
```

### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       full_data=dftrial,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimate="surv_hr",
       search=list(psm="greedy"),
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       psm_arguments=list(tune=TRUE,
                          seed=181299,
                          distance="random forest"),
       method="psm")
```

Print estimates

```{r}
est=B$t0
lower=B$t0-1.96*sd(B$t)
upper=B$t0+1.96*sd(B$t)
# difference
est-beta
```

### mahalanobis

#### single procedure

```{r}
matched=psm_matching(data=dftrial,
                     formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                     ratio=2,
                     replacement=F,
                     distance='mahalanobis',
                     method='greedy',
                     #tune=TRUE,
                     #caliper=0.1,
                     duration=duration,
                     time=time)
```

Get data and run cox model to check results

```{r}
# get data
matcheddf=matched$dataset
# run cox model
model=coxph(Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
              data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
beta=as.numeric(coefficients(model)["trt"])
```

### bootstrap procedure

```{r}
B=boot(data=dftrial,
       R=5,
       full_data=dftrial,
       statistic=boot_matching,
       estimate="surv_hr",
       search=list(psm="greedy"),
       treatment_model=trt~ageonset+sex,
       outcome_model=Surv(time_trial,event)~trt+calendar,
       duration="duration",time="time",
       psm_arguments=list(tune=FALSE,distance="mahalanobis"),
       method="psm")
```

Print estimates

```{r}
est=B$t0
lower=B$t0-1.96*sd(B$t)
upper=B$t0+1.96*sd(B$t)
# difference
est-beta
```
